diagnostics.message: google_essential_contacts_contact.contact requires the Essential Contacts API to be enabled in the target project; when essentialcontacts.googleapis.com is among var.services it is enabled asynchronously by google_project_service.project_services in the same apply. The contact resource has no dependency on the service enablement, so contact creation can race the API enablement and fail with an API-not-enabled/403 error. The module applies this ordering pattern elsewhere (e.g. google_compute_project_metadata_item.default waits for project_services).

google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service attaches this project as a Shared VPC service project, which requires the Compute Engine API to be enabled in the service project. API enablement (google_project_service.project_services) is asynchronous, but this resource has no dependency on it — unlike the host-side counterpart google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host, which does declare depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]. Without the dependency the attachment can race ahead of API enablement and fail intermittently.
